name: splice-db-equals-full-rebuild-for-all-tables
body:
A scan's `db.lbug` and its `graph.jsonl` are two renderings of ONE assembled graph and agree for EVERY table — the authored/transient rows (Stakeholder/User/Requirement/DomainGroup/Entity/Value/Service/System/Container/Component/Person/Constraint/Note and their spine rels; Plan/PlanPhase/Task/Feedback and their rels) exactly as for the code tables. A win-C splice publishes a `db.lbug` that is a full rebuild's projection of the assembled graph for every table; where the projection diverges, the splice declines to publish and the full load runs.

Observable completion: splice a delta whose assembled graph carries authored/transient rows the seed lacks; the resulting `db.lbug` either equals a full-rebuild reference of that same assembled graph on every table, or the splice is refused and the full load runs. In the current code the spliced DB keeps the seed's stale authored rows while `graph.jsonl` is written from the full assembled graph — the two disagree.
